create.title: New Team
create.supportedAgentsHint: Currently supports Claude and Woody assistants. More assistants coming soon.
create.leaderDesc: Understands your goals and coordinates assistants to complete tasks
create.selectAtLeastOneMember: Select at least one assistant as the Team Leader.
create.subtitle: Let multiple AI assistants team up and collaborate. We suggest one team focuses on a single goal — create separate teams for different tasks.
create.membersHelper: Choose team members and assign one Leader. The same assistant can be selected multiple times.
create.memberHint: No suitable assistant as a member? After creation, let the Leader create temporary team members in chat.

isolated.label: Separate workspace
isolated.hint: Creates a new branch from {{branch}} and a new folder next to the repository; the team changes code only there
isolated.dirty: The current folder has uncommitted changes; they are not carried over to the new workspace
isolated.detached: Not on any branch, so a separate workspace cannot be created
isolated.noCommits: The repository has no commits yet, so a separate workspace cannot be created
isolated.notRepository: The selected folder is not in a Git repository
isolated.failed: Could not create the separate workspace: {{message}}

removeAgent.confirmContent: Remove this member from the team?
removeAgent.confirmContentActive: This member is working. Remove it anyway? Its current work will be interrupted.

emptyState.subtitle: Describe your goal and I'll get the team working on it

suggestions.debate: Organize a debate with assistants taking different sides
suggestions.interview: Plan an in-depth interview between assistants
suggestions.expert_review: Have multiple experts analyze the same problem
suggestions.add_member: Help me add a member good at ___ to the team

emptyState.leaderGreeting: Hi, I'm the Leader. I understand your goal and coordinate the team — describe what you want and I'll arrange it.
emptyState.memberGreeting: Hi, I'm a team member. I take direction from the Leader and you.

addMember.title: Add member
addMember.subtitle: The same assistant can be added repeatedly
addMember.tellLeaderHint: Not a good fit? You can also ask the Leader to arrange it.
addMember.tellLeaderPrefill: Help me add a member good at ___ to the team

warmup.title: Waking up the team…
warmup.subtitle: Getting members ready
warmup.memberFailedHint: Switch its model above, or remove it from the bar on top, then retry.
warmup.leaderFailedHint: Switch its model above, then retry.

agentActions.label: Agent actions
agentActions.reconnectDescription: Restart the agent process and keep the current context.

disabled.busy: Wait for the current reply and queued work to finish.
disabled.unsupported: This agent does not support starting a new context.
disabled.leaderNotTargetable: A team leader cannot start a new context.

contextReset.title: Start new context
contextReset.description: Create a new backend session. Chat history and tasks are kept.
contextReset.confirmContent: This will stop the current agent session and create a new backend session for the next message. Chat history, tasks, files, model, and member settings will be kept, but the agent will no longer have the reasoning context from the previous session.
contextReset.partialSuccess: The context was reset for {{memberName}}, but the agent failed to restart. Use Retry start.
contextReset.notApplied: Could not start a new context. The current context was kept.
contextReset.failed: Failed to start a new context. Please try again.

systemNotice.contextResetRuntimeFailed: The context was reset for {{memberName}}, but the agent failed to restart.

workflow.label: Workflow template
workflow.hint: Creates one role per stage from the selected assistant, keeping its model, tools, skills and rules. The first stage also leads the team: it confirms the requirements with you, then hands the work on one stage at a time. You can edit the roles in assistant settings afterwards.
workflow.prepareFailed: Role preparation failed; no team created. Retry to prepare again. Copies not removed: {{ids}}. Manage them in assistant settings.

experts.title: Module experts
experts.empty: No experts yet. Add one per module.
experts.selectWorkspace: Choose the project folder first. The experts are saved in its .woody folder.
experts.unavailable: Module experts are only available in the desktop app.
experts.sharedHint: No expert owns these, such as task tables and common headers. For each goal the dispatcher names one expert to change them.
experts.hint: Creates a dispatcher, the selected experts and a verifier from the selected assistant, keeping its model, tools, skills and rules. The dispatcher works out which expert owns the code, confirms a plan with you, then hands each part to that expert; the verifier builds and checks the combined change. The expert list is saved in the project's .woody folder.
experts.noneSelected: Select at least one expert and complete every expert's details

fields.name: Name
fields.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and -. Also names the feature card .woody/features/<ID>.md.
fields.summaryPlaceholder: What the module does and which requests belong to it
fields.pathsPlaceholder: One per line, relative to the project folder. A folder ends with /; * matches part of a name.

issues.id: Enter an ID made of lowercase letters, digits and -.
issues.idTaken: Another expert already uses this ID.
issues.name: Enter a name of at most 40 characters.
issues.nameTaken: Another expert already uses this name.
issues.summary: Describe the responsibility in at most 400 characters.
issues.paths: List at least one owned file or folder, relative to the project folder, without ..

experts.onboard: Have experts learn their modules after the team is created
experts.onboardHint: Experts whose card is not marked Learned check Woody's brief against the source, complete their card and report to the dispatcher before taking tasks that change code.
experts.onboardWithoutMemory: This project has no codebase memory, so there is no brief: experts learn their modules by reading the source.
experts.onboardMessage: Please learn your module first: follow the "Learning your module" steps in your rules, check the brief Woody generated in {{card}} against the source, trace the module with codebase memory, complete the card, and then report to the dispatcher. Do not change project code while you do this.
experts.onboardFailed: The team was created, but these experts could not be asked to learn their modules: {{names}}. Ask them in their own chats.
